ctaNote: No student accounts needed. Students join with a code and get a safe made-up name.

host.title: Host a live game now
host.lead: Make a teacher account, pick a game, and your students join with a code. No student accounts, no email address, and it is free.
host.step1: Make your teacher account: three boxes.
host.step2: Pick a game and its questions.
host.step3: Put the code on the board. Students join on any device.

signup.submit: Make my account and pick a game
signup.privacy: We keep your name, your username and a scrambled copy of your password. Privacy Policy
signup.have: Already have an account? Sign in

kid.p: Ask your teacher for the game code, then join here.

quick.title: Quick game
quick.forClass: For {name}. Only students of this class can join, signed in as themselves.
quick.open: Anyone with the code can join. No student accounts: every player gets a safe made-up name.
quick.hasOpen: You already have a game open: {title}.
quick.subject: Subject
quick.what: {count} ready-made questions, new every game. You press Start when everyone is in.

results.now: Players had no accounts, so nothing went into a gradebook. The question review on this page is kept. The players' game names and scores are not: you can see them here for a few minutes only.
results.saved: Players had no accounts, so no names or scores were kept and nothing went into a gradebook. The question review is kept.
results.keep: Make a class to keep scores
results.keepHint: Paste your students' names and print their login cards. Scores from your class games are then saved.

keep.title: Make a class to keep scores
keep.h: Make a class to keep scores
keep.lead: Paste your students' names. Each student gets a login card. From then on, the scores of your class games are saved with their names, for you.
keep.namesHint: One name on each line. First names are enough.
keep.go: Make the class and the login cards
keep.note: Only you and your school's staff see the names you type here.
